cards.title: Parts of speech
body: A noun names a person, place, or thing: Asmara, student, book.
A verb shows an action or a state: write, is, studied.
An adjective describes a noun: a long exam. An adverb describes a verb: she answered clearly.

units.title: Sentences
units.intro: A sentence needs a subject and a finite verb.

cards.title: Sentences
body: A sentence has a subject and a finite verb.
The student opened the book. Subject: the student. Verb: opened.
A fragment has no finite verb: Opening the book.
